mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHATBOT_LINK_CLICK (message_id, conversation_id, user_idx, anon_session_id, url, label, ip_address) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{conversationId}, #{userIdx}, #{anonSessionId}, #{url}, #{label}, #{ipAddress})
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(clicked_at) AS clickDate, COUNT(*) AS clickCount FROM CHATBOT_LINK_CLICK WHERE clicked_at >= #{from} AND clicked_at < #{to} GROUP BY DATE(clicked_at) ORDER BY clickDate ASC
